help: Choose the exact dataset revision and columns to include. The selected values become a publication table; other dataset values and private source files are excluded. The table is checked against its pinned dataset when the record is saved.
count: Maximum rows to include (leave empty for all remaining rows)
includeExcluded: Include excluded rows and their reasons
invalid: Choose a retained dataset, columns and a valid row range.
paged: This table reads its selected values from a pinned dataset revision. Preview pages do not limit the retained selection.
